The short answer

Choose your IPTV subscription for your household in Canada. Start with your channels, languages, device and the number of screens you watch at the same time.

Start with the Canadian details

Confirm that the provider is authorised to distribute the channels you want in Canada. Ask about the precise regional feed, not just a general category.

Make the total price clear

Check that the quoted price is in Canadian dollars, whether any taxes apply, and how much is due for the entire term. Ask if renewal is manual or automatic.

Try your normal viewing setup

Use your own device and home connection to test the experience. Watch during your usual hours and confirm simultaneous stream rules.

Before you choose a plan.

Keep your device model, viewing list and preferred term together. Ask the operator to confirm the complete catalogue, price, payment route, service terms and refund policy for your location.

IPTV IN CANADA

Your Canadian IPTV questions, answered.

Is Lumina Stream intended for viewers in Canada?

Yes. Lumina Stream is focused on Canada, with prices in Canadian dollars and website guides in English and French. Check the exact channel lineup and device compatibility for your selected plan before payment.

How do IPTV subscriptions for Canada work?

Choose a plan, a prepaid term of 1, 3, 6 or 12 months, and 1, 2 or 3 simultaneous streams. Compare the full CAD total, then review your device and viewing preferences at checkout. Plans do not renew automatically.

Can I request English and French channels in Canada?

Use the channel request tool to list your preferred English, French and other channels. Confirm specific channel names, Canadian feeds and plan availability before subscribing. A viewing category does not guarantee a particular channel.
